name: Raspberry Jam
ingredients: Sugar, raspberry (45%) (raspberry, raspberry juice from concentrate), gelling agent (440), acidity regulators (330, 333).
storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Once opened, keep refrigerated at 0-4°C.
note: Back label only; the brand name is on the front of the jar, which is turned away and not legible in frame. Net weight is not printed on the photographed face - 450 g is derived from the panel's own 45 servings x 10 g. No allergen statement appears on the visible face.
